taglineIntent: a members' running event: energy, a shared start line, an open invitation to sign up
moodIntent: a weekend race members train for together; momentum, a clear route and a friendly start line; the page should feel like the week before race day

components.name: Race distance card
components.role: compare the distances on offer and pick one
components.contentNotes: distance, start time, cut-off time, member price, one select action per card

components.name: Route overview
components.role: show the course and its checkpoints
components.contentNotes: a labelled map image slot, checkpoints with distance markers, water stations

components.name: Race-day schedule
components.contentNotes: time, item and place for check-in, warm-up, start, finish and awards

components.name: Registration call-out
components.role: carry the one main registration action
components.contentNotes: registration deadline, the member benefit, the main action

dos: show the registration deadline next to every main action
donts: use the route map as a decorative background, because runners need to read it
promptInputs: a set of race distance cards for 5K, 10K and 21K
a registration call-out with its deadline
